I can’t cancel events directly because no calendar tools are available here. I can, however, prepare everything you need (confirmation, exact cancellation text, and step‑by‑step instructions for Google Calendar or Outlook) so you can cancel the series quickly.

Before I prepare those, please confirm the scope (required for a destructive change):

- Which series should be cancelled?
  - A) Both "Operations Sync" recurring series: Tuesdays 09:00 America/Chicago (12 attendees) AND Thursdays 15:00 America/Chicago (4 attendees). 
  - B) Only one of them — if so, which (Tuesdays or Thursdays)?
- Do you want to cancel:
  - 1) The entire future series for the selected event(s) (delete all future occurrences), effective starting tomorrow (i.e., remove all occurrences on or after tomorrow), or
  - 2) Only the next occurrence(s) starting tomorrow (leave the rest of the series intact)?
- Do you want to send a cancellation notice to attendees? (Yes / No)
- Which calendar system do you use and want step-by-step instructions for? (Google Calendar / Outlook / other)

If you confirm “Both” + “Entire future series” + “Send cancellation,” I will:
- Provide a ready-to-send cancellation message (one for all attendees and an optional separate note for each series),
- Give exact steps for cancelling the series in Google Calendar and in Outlook,
- Indicate the effective date (tomorrow: 2026-07-13) so you can copy/paste.

Example cancellation message I can tailor once you confirm scope:
"Subject: Cancellation — Operations Sync (effective July 13, 2026)
Hi all,
Effective July 13, 2026, the weekly Operations Sync meetings (Tuesdays 9:00 AM CT and Thursdays 3:00 PM CT) are cancelled. Thank you — please let me know if you have any questions.
[Your name]"

Reply with your choices for the four confirmation points above and I’ll produce the exact messages and step-by-step cancel instructions.
